in_hindi.name: बोरुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the son of joy

in_marathi.name: Borun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Borun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Born from the divine asura (demon) Bhrama, Borun is a significant figure in Hindu mythology. He is the king of Asuras and the brother of Vritra, the demon king who was slain by Indra. Borun's name symbolizes strength, courage, and the power to overcome adversity.

He is the king of Asuras and the brother of Vritra, the demon king who was slain by Indra. Borun's name symbolizes strength, courage, and the power to overcome adversity.
